using ll = long long;

const int MAXN = 250250;
ll fact[MAXN], rfact[MAXN];
ll g[MAXN][17];
int n, k, p;
int cnt = 0;

ll binpow(ll a, int b, int mod) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        b /= 2;
    }
    return res;
}

void dfs(int cur_n, const vector<int>& bit, int pos, int mask) {
    if (pos == (int)bit.size()) {
        ++cnt;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            g[cur_n][i] += rfact[mask] * g[cur_n ^ mask][i - 1];
            if (cnt >= 8) {
                g[cur_n][i] %= p;
            }
        }
        if (cnt >= 8) cnt = 0;
        return;
    }
    dfs(cur_n, bit, pos + 1, mask);
    dfs(cur_n, bit, pos + 1, mask ^ (1 << bit[pos]));
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cout.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> n >> k >> p;
    if (n & 1) {
        cout << binpow(k, n, p) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    fact[0] = 1;
    rfact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p;
        rfact[i] = binpow(fact[i], p - 2, p);
    }
    g[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if ((i & n) != i) continue;
        vector<int> bits;
        bits.reserve(18);
        for (int j = 0; j < 18; ++j) {
            if ((1 << j) & i) bits.push_back(j);
        }
        dfs(i, bits, 1, 1 << bits[0]);
        for (int j = 0; j < 17; ++j) g[i][j] %= p;
    }
    ll ans = 0;
    int lim = min(16, k);
    for (int i = 1; i <= lim; ++i) {
        g[n][i] %= p;
        ll cur = fact[n] * g[n][i];
        cur %= p;
        cur *= fact[k];
        cur %= p;
        cur *= rfact[k - i];
        cur %= p;
        ans += cur;
        ans %= p;
    }
    ans = binpow(k, n, p) - ans;
    if (ans < 0) ans += p;
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
